name: g80_allyswitch_partnerabsent_hit
purpose: Ally Switch with no partner (step G80, decision 0044), then Stomping Tantrum on the next turn, which hits: Audino uses Ally Switch while its partner is fainted (step 12; the onHit returns NOT_FAIL, so the result is null, data/moves.ts:326-328). Stomping Tantrum is not doubled (basePowerCallback doubles only when moveLastTurnResult === false, data/moves.ts:18054), so its damage is the undoubled one; a result of false would double it. Taken from the random differential battle fz_80_293 of run 80 (its first 14 answers), which the pinned Showdown accepted.
